findings.title: Loan COB cannot settle transfer 1: LOAN product id 2 has no LOAN PORTFOLIO GL mapping, so the investor accounting helper throws before posting any journal entry
observed: POST /jobs/34?command=executeJob returned HTTP 202 and job 34 reports success at job level; the investor step failure is WARN-level per-loan skip, not job failure.
Application log shows BusinessStepException for Loan(id=6) on five attempts (COB-Thread-11..15), then 'Skipping was triggered'.

Root cause ProductToGLAccountMappingNotFoundException: Mapping for product of type LOAN with Id 2 does not exist for an account of type LOAN PORTFOLIO, thrown at InvestorAccountingHelper.java:128 from AccountingServiceImpl.createJournalEntries (:209,:115) via createJournalEntriesForSaleAssetTransfer (:65) from LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep.sellAsset (:189) / sellAssetOrDecline (:169) / handleSale (:119) / execute (:108,:55).
DB: acc_product_mapping rows = 0; m_external_asset_owner_transfer_details rows = 0; transfer id 1 still status=PENDING, purchase_price_ratio=97.25; acc_gl_journal_entry rows for entity_id=1 = 0.
Business date 2026-09-02 (past settlement 2026-09-01); COB date 2026-09-01; rounding-mode enabled value=4 (HALF_UP); enable-business-date enabled=true value=null.
findings.disposition: Recorded, not worked around. Inserting an acc_product_mapping row would synthesise reference data the oracle does not have and would be a fabricated observation. The refusal IS the finding; it is the reason the transfer has never settled.
